subject: ADR-162: the pheno tracker, recorded whole -- weighted scoring, keepers, mothers, crosses and segregation, entered and exported
body: THE PHENO TRACKER -- pheno-tracker.html, a plant breeder's selection bench (score every plant on weighted trait dials, star keepers, read the SELECTION DIFFERENTIAL S that times heritability predicts the response, plan mothers and crosses, and test a segregation count against the Mendelian ratios by chi-square) -- SCORED A RUN OF EIGHT, starred three keepers and read S = +1.44, but nine of its sixteen fields were never entered: the run's name/observer/date, the per-plant note, the mother promotion and the two cross-parent pickers, the trait weight, and the segregation trait name. It computed the number a breeder lives by and never recorded whose run it was. The existing scenario is kept verbatim (eight scores, three keepers, run mean 2.41, keeper mean 3.85, differential +1.44, three segregation chi-square tests), so its assertions hold, and the nine untouched fields are driven around it: the run named and stamped, a standout noted, a plant promoted to mother, a cross planned between two keepers, the trait weight and segregation trait set. Both files the bench exports are then read and held against an oracle: the field-day report (header and stamp, each plant's weighted score -- #1 4.18 KEEP with its note -- the keeper line with S=+1.44, the 60:20 segregation cross) and the CSV (the weighted-trait header, #1's row 5,4,4,4 -> 4.18 keep verbatim). Every weighted mean, the differential and the ratios are computed the page's way from the four dial weights (vigor x1, structure x1, aroma x2, resistance x1.5), so both sides of every claim come from the same arithmetic. pheno-tracker 7 -> 16 OF 16 FIELDS, 0 -> 2 exports held, 77 -> 102 confirmed and 0 refuted, and the kit 481 -> 490 of 521 (94%), 19 of 27 pages entered whole. Held: the mother is promoted on a non-keeper and the cross planned between keepers so neither disturbs the asserted keeper line or plant row; the trait name and weight are entered WITHOUT adding a trait -- adding one puts an unscored dial on every plant, a field only closeable by scoring it, which would move the totals the run is trusted for. No page was edited -- a task-only slice, the twelfth page driven end to end.
